note: Heading of the staff sign-in page.

sw: Konsoli ya wafanyakazi ya Olink Desk
note: Line under the sign-in heading. 'Olink Desk' is a product name — keep it.
Form label: the organization's short identifier used to sign in.

en: Your workspace's short name — for example demo
am: የሥራ ቦታዎ አጭር ስም — ለምሳሌ demo
om: Maqaa gabaabaa iddoo hojii keessanii — fakkeenyaaf demo
ti: ሓጺር ስም ናይ ስራሕ ቦታኹም — ንኣብነት demo
so: Magaca gaaban ee goobta shaqadaada — tusaale demo
sw: Jina fupi la eneo lako la kazi — kwa mfano demo
note: Help text under the workspace field. 'demo' is a literal example value — keep it.
Form label for the email field.
Form label for the password field.
The sign-in button.
Button text while the sign-in request is running.

am: የሥራ ቦታ፣ ኢሜይል ወይም የይለፍ ቃል ተሳስቷል።
om: Iddoon hojii, imeeliin yookaan jechi darbii dogoggora.
ti: ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ፣ ኢመይል ወይ መሕለፊ ቃል ተጋግዩ እዩ።
so: Goobta shaqada, iimaylka ama erayga sirta ah waa khalad.
sw: Eneo la kazi, barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.
note: Error when workspace/email/password do not match. Deliberately does not say which was wrong.

en: Too many attempts — try again in a few minutes.
am: ብዙ ሙከራዎች ነበሩ — ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በኋላ ይሞክሩ።
om: Yaaliin baay'een tureera — daqiiqaa muraasa booda irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
ti: ብዙሕ ፈተነታት ነይሩ — ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደቓይቕ ፈትኑ።
so: Isku dayo badan ayaa dhacay — dhawr daqiiqo ka dib isku day.
sw: Majaribio mengi mno — jaribu tena baada ya dakika chache.
note: Error after repeated failed sign-ins; the account unlocks by itself.
The sign-out button in the console header.
Heading of the Channels page (Telegram, WhatsApp, SMS…).
Line under the Channels heading. {org} is the organization's name.
Shown while a page or card is fetching data.
Badge on a channel that is connected and working.
Badge on a channel that is built but not yet connected.
Heading of the list of things required to connect a channel.
Label of the input where the admin pastes the Telegram bot token. @BotFather is Telegram's official bot — keep the name.
Button that saves the pasted token and registers the webhook.
Button text while connecting.
Success line. {bot} is the bot's Telegram username, shown as @name.

en: Pasting a new token replaces the current connection. If you revoke the token in BotFather, paste the new one here straight away.
am: አዲስ ቶክን መለጠፍ አሁን ያለውን ግንኙነት ይተካል። በBotFather ቶክኑን ከሰረዙ አዲሱን ወዲያውኑ እዚህ ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookinii haaraa maxxansuun walqabsiisa ammaa bakka bu'a. BotFather keessatti tookinii yoo haqxan, isa haaraa battalumatti asitti maxxansaa.
ti: ሓድሽ ቶክን ምልጣፍ ነቲ ዘሎ ርክብ ይትክኦ። ኣብ BotFather ቶክን እንተሰሪዝኩም፣ ነቲ ሓድሽ ብቕጽበት ኣብዚ ለጥፉዎ።
so: Ku dhejinta tookin cusub waxay beddeshaa xiriirka hadda jira. Haddii aad tookinka ka burisid BotFather, kan cusub isla markiiba halkan ku dheji.
sw: Kubandika tokeni mpya hubadilisha muunganisho wa sasa. Ukifuta tokeni katika BotFather, bandika mpya hapa mara moja.
note: Help text: pasting a new token replaces the old one, and a token revoked in BotFather must be re-pasted. 'Revoke' is BotFather's own action name.

en: The stored token no longer works — it was revoked in BotFather. Paste the current token to reconnect.
am: የተቀመጠው ቶክን ከአሁን በኋላ አይሰራም — በBotFather ተሰርዟል። ለመገናኘት አሁን ያለውን ቶክን ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookiniin kuufame kana booda hin hojjetu — BotFather keessatti haqameera. Walqabsiisuuf tookinii ammaa maxxansaa.
ti: እቲ ዝተቐመጠ ቶክን ደጊም ኣይሰርሕን እዩ — ኣብ BotFather ተሰሪዙ እዩ። ንምርኻብ ነቲ ሕጂ ዘሎ ቶክን ለጥፉ።
so: Tookinka kaydsan hadda ma shaqeeyo — waxaa laga buriyay BotFather. Si aad dib ugu xirto, ku dheji tookinka hadda jira.
sw: Tokeni iliyohifadhiwa haifanyi kazi tena — ilifutwa katika BotFather. Bandika tokeni ya sasa ili kuunganisha upya.
note: Warning when the saved token no longer works because it was revoked. Tells the admin the one action that fixes it.
Status line: Telegram has our webhook registered. 'Webhook' is a technical term — keep it.

en: Telegram is pointing somewhere else — paste the token again to fix it.
am: Telegram ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እያመለከተ ነው — ለማስተካከል ቶክኑን እንደገና ይለጥፉ።
om: Telegram bakka biraa agarsiisaa jira — sirreessuuf tookinii irra deebi'aa maxxansaa.
ti: Telegram ናብ ካልእ ቦታ የመልክት ኣሎ — ንምእራም ነቲ ቶክን ደጊምኩም ለጥፉ።
so: Telegram meel kale ayuu tilmaamayaa — si aad u saxdo, tookinka mar kale ku dheji.
sw: Telegram inaelekeza mahali pengine — bandika tokeni tena ili kurekebisha.
note: Warning: Telegram is registered to a different address; re-pasting the token repairs it.

ti: ናይ Telegram ናይ መወዳእታ ናይ ምልኣኽ ጌጋ: {error}
sw: Hitilafu ya mwisho ya utumaji ya Telegram: {error}
note: Shows Telegram's own most recent delivery error. {error} is the raw message from Telegram, usually English.
Error when the connect attempt is rejected. {error} is the reason.
Status line for a channel with nothing connected yet.
Shown when the console could not reach Telegram to check. {error} is the reason.
